name: DXY-weak meta-labeled crypto momentum (dollar gate + win-prob sizing)
rationale: Same dollar-weak momentum thesis, but with a triple-barrier meta-label that SIZES/SKIPS each primary trade by its predicted win probability (it never flips side). Thesis: the dollar-weak window is the primary edge, and a secondary logistic on funding_rate + fear_greed + vol_realized read point-in-time at entry further separates the high-quality dollar-weak entries from the marginal ones. dxy is drifting -> read ONLY as cross_down to arm; the meta-label features are bounded/registry features each with their own fitted lookback. DISCONFIRMER (two controls): (1) the SAME dollar-gated momentum book WITHOUT the meta-label, and (2) a bare momentum book with NO dollar gate and NO meta-label. This spec must beat BOTH on the Gate; if the meta-label adds nothing over control (1) it is overfit noise, and if control (2) already matches, the dollar channel itself is a STOP. CONTROL EXIT on dxy cross_up isolates the dollar-weak window.
catalyst: positive medium-term momentum while the dollar is weakening, filtered to high win-probability entries
